scope: Real hosted Token Factory inference, local MuJoCo simulation/rendering, LeRobot 0.5.1 loading and training batch, simulator action replay, and failed-grasp negative control. No robot policy optimization, physical robot operation, or remote Kubernetes/S3 execution.
preview_transform: none; identical bytes to recorded synchronized two-camera preview
development_findings: Native LeRobot initially read numeric task labels from the shared adapter; fixed Parquet index metadata and verified language labels through the upstream reader.
The first action replay differed because per-frame render callbacks invoked mj_forward. Moved scene initialization before rollout; final replay matched all 185 pre/post joint states exactly.
routing_evaluation: Six development scenarios, three explicit scene extraction and three spatial planning; not a held-out routing-quality benchmark.
cache_scope: Provider-reported prompt-cache counters in a warm development workload; no application response cache or GPU memory inspection.
native_validator_followup: Extracted the video-decoding helper for readability after the live test, then reran the final native validator against the same original artifacts; all checks passed.
